protocol.difficult_stratum: separation_stress: Y=1(M2>0); original separation must reject; no finite logit truth and no coverage claim
protocol.coefficient_intervals: classical t for homoscedastic linear; normal HC3 for heteroscedastic; model-based normal z for logistic
protocol.success_rule: production >=95% successful bootstrap draws; every original/overall failure reported
protocol.selection: all equation coefficients; specific indirects at every fixed probe; direct effects; all indices/derivatives; specific-indirect condition contrasts
protocol.inference: pointwise; no familywise error control or causal/logistic probability estimands
protocol.execution: 8 independent R processes by default; installed namespace; no estimator/bootstrap substitutions
